term.risk.name: Risk
term.risk.simple: The chance of ending up with less than you hoped.
term.risk.life: Shares that are worth less next year than today.
term.risk.real: Risk = the chance that an investment earns less than expected or loses value.
term.investmentReturn.name: Return
term.investmentReturn.real: Return = the gain or loss on money put in, usually given as a percent a year.
term.volatility.name: Volatility
term.volatility.simple: How sharply a price jumps up and down.
term.volatility.life: A share that is ₹100, then ₹80, then ₹110 within a few months.
term.volatility.real: Volatility = how much and how often a price moves.
term.diversification.name: Diversification
term.diversification.simple: Not keeping all your eggs in one basket.
term.diversification.life: Some money in a deposit, some in gold, some in a fund.
term.diversification.real: Diversification = spreading money across different kinds of asset so that one fall cannot sink everything.
term.equity.name: Equity
term.equity.simple: Owning a piece of a business.
term.equity.real: Equity = ownership. Owners share in the gains and the losses.
term.debt.name: Debt
term.debt.simple: Lending money and earning interest on it.
term.debt.life: A fixed deposit: you lend to the bank and it pays you interest.
term.debt.real: Debt (as an investment) = money lent in return for interest.
term.mutualFund.name: Mutual fund
term.mutualFund.simple: Many people's money pooled and invested together.
term.mutualFund.life: Thousands of people each put in ₹500. A manager buys a basket of shares with it.
term.mutualFund.real: Mutual fund = a pooled investment run by a manager. You own units of it.
term.sip.name: SIP
term.sip.simple: Putting in a fixed amount every month.
term.sip.life: ₹500 goes into a fund on the 5th of every month.
term.sip.real: SIP = Systematic Investment Plan: a fixed amount invested in a mutual fund at regular intervals.
term.rupeeCostAveraging.name: Rupee-cost averaging
term.rupeeCostAveraging.simple: The same amount buys more when prices are low and less when they are high.
term.rupeeCostAveraging.life: Your ₹500 buys 5 units at ₹100 each, and about 6 units when the price falls to ₹80.
term.rupeeCostAveraging.real: Rupee-cost averaging = investing a fixed amount regularly, so the average cost per unit evens out over time.
term.indexFund.name: Index fund
term.indexFund.simple: A fund that copies a list of companies.
term.indexFund.life: A fund that simply holds the companies on a well-known market list.
term.indexFund.real: Index fund = a mutual fund that copies a market index. It usually charges a lower fee than an actively managed fund.
term.expenseRatio.name: Expense ratio
term.expenseRatio.simple: The yearly fee a fund charges.
term.expenseRatio.life: A fee of 1% a year on ₹10,000 is ₹100 a year.
term.expenseRatio.real: Expense ratio = a fund's yearly cost as a percent of the money in it.
term.sebi.name: SEBI
term.sebi.simple: The regulator of India's share and mutual fund markets.
term.sebi.life: The body that sets the rules funds and brokers must follow.
term.sebi.real: SEBI = Securities and Exchange Board of India: the regulator of the securities market.
term.goldEtf.name: Gold ETF
term.goldEtf.simple: A regulated way to hold gold without holding the metal.
term.goldEtf.life: Buying units that track the price of gold, in an account.
term.goldEtf.real: Gold ETF = a regulated fund that holds gold. Its units are bought and sold like shares.
term.makingCharges.name: Making charges
term.makingCharges.simple: The jeweller's fee for crafting gold.
term.makingCharges.life: An 8% charge on ₹3,000 of jewellery is ₹240.
term.makingCharges.real: Making charges = the fee added for crafting jewellery. It is not paid back when you sell.
term.share.name: Share
term.share.simple: A small piece of a company that you own.
term.share.life: Owning one share of a company that has a lakh shares.
term.share.real: Share = one unit of ownership in a company.
term.sensexNifty.name: Sensex and Nifty
term.sensexNifty.simple: Scoreboards for groups of large companies.
term.sensexNifty.life: "The market is up today" usually means these numbers rose.
term.sensexNifty.real: Sensex and Nifty = indexes that track the shares of groups of large companies.
term.dematAccount.name: Demat account
term.dematAccount.simple: An account that holds your shares electronically.
term.dematAccount.life: Shares sit in it the way money sits in a bank account.
term.dematAccount.real: Demat account = an electronic account that holds shares and other securities.
term.assetClass.name: Asset class
term.assetClass.simple: A kind of asset, such as deposits, gold or shares.
term.hallmark.name: Hallmark
term.hallmark.simple: The stamp that certifies the purity of gold.
term.illiquid.name: Illiquid
term.illiquid.simple: Hard to sell quickly for its full value.
term.sgb.name: Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB)
term.sgb.simple: A government bond linked to the price of gold.
term.digitalGold.name: Digital gold
term.digitalGold.simple: Gold bought through an app. Check who regulates the seller before buying.
term.nav.name: NAV
term.nav.simple: Net Asset Value: the price of one unit of a mutual fund.
term.unit.name: Unit
term.unit.simple: One share of a mutual fund.
term.lumpsum.name: Lumpsum
term.lumpsum.simple: One amount invested all at once.
term.amc.name: AMC
term.amc.simple: Asset Management Company: the company that runs a mutual fund.
term.directRegular.name: Direct and Regular plans
term.directRegular.simple: Regular plans include a distributor's commission. Direct plans do not.
term.dividend.name: Dividend
term.dividend.simple: A share of a company's profit paid to its owners.
term.stockExchange.name: Stock exchange
term.stockExchange.simple: The market where shares are bought and sold.
term.timeHorizon.name: Time horizon
term.timeHorizon.simple: How long money can stay untouched before you need it.
term.assetAllocation.name: Asset allocation
term.assetAllocation.simple: How your money is split across kinds of asset.
